topScam.title: The "Look-Alike Voice" AI Deepfake Distress Call
topScam.scam: An elderly parent receives a call that sounds identically like their son or daughter crying in panic: "Dad, I was in a car crash / police detained me, please send ₹50,000 to this inspector's UPI immediately to avoid lockup." The voice is an AI clone generated from a 5-second public Instagram clip.
topScam.protection: Establish a family secret safe-word. Never transfer money under emotional pressure. Hang up immediately and dial your child's number directly on a normal voice call or video call.

realityPick.title: The Fine-Tuning Money Pit
symptoms: fine tuning failed to memorize facts
realityPick.myth: Fine-tune a private custom model on your company's proprietary data to teach it your domain!
realityPick.reality: Fine-tuning adjusts style, tone, and grammar format — it does NOT reliably store retrievable factual knowledge. It induces catastrophic forgetting of base capabilities while rapidly growing stale when company documents update.
realityPick.fix: Keep the base model frozen. Use high-accuracy RAG with hybrid search for proprietary knowledge, and run open-weight models on-premise for zero ongoing API fees.
realityPick.impact: Companies spend ₹25,00,000 on GPU cluster compute to fine-tune a model that hallucinates worse than off-the-shelf models with clean retrieval.
